answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact. A fake identity that misbehaves forfeits its stake, so spinning up thousands of Sybils means funding thousands of stakes, and the cost climbs like a canyon wall while honest agents trade cheaply. Each verified deal sends a ripple of trust through counterparties, and that history polishes an agent reputation smooth as a marble: expensive to fake, cheap to check.
